rationale: Early infection starts with viral entry and local epithelial infection, then spreads to olfactory and lower respiratory tissues and can trigger viremia and systemic inflammation. Lung injury and capillary leakage are downstream of alveolar/endothelial infection. Symptoms like dry cough, productive cough, and anosmia/ageusia are downstream manifestations of these infections.
